pages: Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the table, both hands on one black instrument box, its lid open. Middle distance: a cold mug, a coiled lead. Background: a dark window, a red-lit door. Red lamp light only.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the table with one squared notebook open, a pencil on a line of figures. Middle distance: the black instrument box, a cold mug. Background: a dark window, scattered stars. Red lamp light.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, leaning back, one hand flat on the closed black instrument box, listening. Middle distance: a spiral notebook of counts, a desk lamp switched off. Background: a dark window, the black dome. Deep night.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, holding one pocket calculator in both hands, a thumb on its keys. Middle distance: the squared notebook, the closed black instrument box, a vacuum flask. Background: a dark window, the dome. Red lamp light on her hands.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the table over one thick observing log, a pen down its open face. Middle distance: a wall clock, the black instrument box, a folding chair. Background: a dark window, stars. Red lamp light on the clock.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the desk with one sheet of typing paper under her hand, a pen in her fist. Middle distance: a typewriter, a stack of forms. Background: a dark window, a strip light overhead. Red lamp light.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, writing one line across the back of the observing log, the pencil pressed hard. Middle distance: the black instrument box, a wall clock. Background: a dark window, the ridge. Red lamp light, deep night.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, standing with one sheet of the night's log in both hands. Middle distance: the desk, the black instrument box. Background: a dark window, thin high cloud on the ridge. Red lamp light, grey outside.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, over the table, one hand on a small square of sky in a slide tray. Middle distance: the black instrument box, its lid off, the notebook. Background: a narrow window, stars. Red lamp light on the tray.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the observing desk, one fingertip on a single lit button of a small control box. Middle distance: the notebook, a mug, a chair. Background: a window slit to the sky. Red lamp light, one green lamp.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the desk with one wooden slide rule held flat by a finger. Middle distance: the squared notebook, the black instrument box. Background: a dark window, dawn at its edge. Red lamp light, night ending.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the desk with one hardbound notebook open, a pen across the face she filled. Middle distance: the calculator, the black instrument box. Background: a dark window, a red line under the door. Red lamp light, late.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, with one sheet of graph paper flat under both hands, a plot in ink down it. Middle distance: the notebook, the black instrument box. Background: a dark window, the dome, stars. Red lamp light across the sheet.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, laying one sheet of tracing paper over the plot, a pencil run along the curve. Middle distance: the squared notebook, the pocket calculator. Background: a dark window, the dome. Red lamp light, three nights on one sheet.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, holding one squared notebook open in both hands, a pencil tip on a line of figures. Middle distance: the desk, the black instrument box. Background: a dark window, the ridge. Red lamp light on the paper.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the desk with one letter sheet unfolded in her hand, the other hand on the notebook. Middle distance: the black instrument box, a cold mug. Background: a dark window, the dome. Red lamp light on it.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the desk in grey morning light, one closed notebook under her flat hand. Middle distance: a cold coffee, the black instrument box, a sheet face down. Background: a window with daylight on it. Thin cold daylight.

Marama Ngata, a woman of fifty, black hair in a low bun, a charcoal wool jumper, a red lamp on her left wrist, at the desk, one notebook open to columns, her pen against it. Middle distance: the red lamp, a cold mug, the instrument box. Background: a dark window, the dome, September sky. Red lamp light.
